reviews.text: We live in Northeast Ohio and recently had our custom pool enclosure installed. From design to installation took about 3 months and even was delivered a week ahead of schedule. The install was flawless. Truck arrived at 8:00am with the enclosure,  and installed completely by 2:00pm. I would like to offer a special shoutout to Alex, Dan and the install crew for their help and professionalism during this project. My family can now enjoy the heated pool year round. We highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Lorn Mahoney

reviews.text: We love our Laguna enclosure. We find it to be an essential and attractive add-on to our north Georgia mountain foothills home pool/spa. The pool stays cleaner and since we have solar and propane heaters we can use it year round. Everyone who sees it asks about it and wants to see how it works. Their minds are blown when they see how sturdy and well-engineered it is, and how I can open/close it just pushing with one finger. If you’re investing in a pool for your home, highly recommend you add an enclosure.
reviews.author: Bob Steinke

reviews.text: Pool and Spa Enclosures, LLC rocks. I have an unusual application for my enclosure, which serves as a retractable roof for a residential rooftop astronomical observatory. The design and workmanship are top-notch, and my custom Imperia enclosure does a great job of protecting my valuable telescope and equipment and my house below it. Mike, Dan, and Alex are the best. They supported a conference call with my builder and my designer to answer questions, Mike was really helpful with a lot of back and forth to finalize the details, and Dan let me check out his own pool enclosure in person at his house before I finalized my specs and made my order. I'm very happy and would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Paul Geithner

reviews.text: My experience with Pool & Spa Enclosures was fantastic from start to finish. I dealt with Mike who was friendly, helpful, informative and detail oriented every step. I felt the process was smooth and answered all questions I have. I live in NJ and run a swim school out of my backyard pool year-round. This enclosure provided warmth for both the swimmers and their family members even when we were in the single digits during a freezing winter. I opted for the UV protection polycarbonate for the added protection from the sun and they are great. I have had my enclosure for a full year now and it is definitely worth it. I would highly recommend to anyone wanting to invest in an enclosure for their pool.
reviews.author: Tiffany Krzyzkowski

reviews.text: Very professional and truly cared about customers satisfaction (me). They were very helpful and clear with communications. They were always available to talk to in person and quickly responded to emails. The enclosure is exactly what they said it was and very well made.  I can literally push and pull each section with one finger it is so easy.  Very pleased and happy I didn’t go with competitors solution.   I spent over a year researching different companies and solutions.
reviews.author: Corey Krebs

reviews.text:
Did alot of research. Found Pool and Spa Enclosures in Monroe. I am so happy I chose them. Alex and Dan were so helpful.  They explained which one I should order for the size pool I had and why. They were so informative about their enclosures.  I am now in my pool every day for as long as I want. All year.It is one the greatest investment. No more traveling just walk out to my backyard.
Thank you, Linda Armhold
reviews.author: Chud Lockie

reviews.text: We love our Universe Type VI enclosure.  We live in the high Colorado Rockies and the enclosure makes it possible for us to use our pool year-round.  It's aesthetically pleasing and extremely functional.  In addition, the people at Pool & Spa have been extraordinarily polite, helpful and effective throughout the purchase, installation and service process.  Five starts isn't enough.  Thanks, Pool & Spa!
reviews.author: ghoyl

reviews.text:
Thus far we LOVE our enclosure.   I'm hoping to be able to keep the pool open in the winter too!
I got the clear panels and just love how it looks in the yard.   The workmanship is superb.   Tomas and Lucas were very professional with the installation.
We had our measurements done by the company and recommend that route as we were afraid that the assembly wouldn't come out right otherwise.   It just gave peace of mind.
The vent option is ingenious, to be able to open up a little to let the hot air escape without getting bugs inside.   On that note, definitely invest in the screen doors for the same reason,  to create airflow,  let the hot air out and keep bugs out too.
Another suggestion,  if you have 6 guys there to help with just moving the panels.   Be ready with a chainsaw and all them to break down the huge shipping pallet before they leave.   It took us most of the next day to tear it down.
Overall we just love the pool now that it's enclosed.  The ability to swim at night without fear of bugs,  and after a rain and not have to clean it,  and to play music inside with the doors shut and not disturb anyone, is priceless.
I also must give all credit to Alex an Dan.  They always called me back, and answered my multitude of questions with patience, honesty and professionalism.
They are legitimate and caring.   I would buy from them again,  and recommend their product unreservedly !
reviews.author: Ava Darensbourg- Smallwood

reviews.text: We just completed the install of our Universe V Pool Enclosure and find it is everything the company promised.  The engineering of this product is most impressive, as was communication throughout the entire purchase transaction.  All of the enclosure components are of top quality, and all parts fit precisely into place.  We chose to install the enclosure ourselves and found the instructions (video plus documentation) detailed and thorough.  The company execs were always available to answer questions and to clarify things, but we only called them about one detail.  It will not be surprising to find this company's pool enclosures being installed throughout the US as word gets around.  The most amazing thing was to find that, as promised, the enclosure components do telescope in and out very easily, and that this operation can be performed by one person with no effort.  Make no mistake: this install is a major project, but thanks to the product's engineering plus the quality and precision of the enclosure components it can be accomplished by a small team with excellent results.
reviews.author: Kristin Isley

reviews.text: The enclosure far exceeds our expectations regarding functionality, ease of use and elegant appearance. The design and engineering are amazing.It has now survived a tropical storm and ice storm both and allows us to swim year round at the constant temperature at which we keep our pool . We are very pleased.Customer support through the installation and interaction with our contractor was excellent.
reviews.author: michael freedman

reviews.text:
I research enclosures for 18 months not sure of which way to go, but then I decided on pool and spa enclosures , it was one of the best decisions I have ever made. Alex an Dan had my back all the way with the install process. Any questions I had they were there for me. I'm totally pleased, what a way to cover and protect your investment. Over the top quality enclosure.

Thanks again, Alex an Dan
reviews.author: Mike Canington

reviews.text: Our enclosure was installed in late Nov 2021.  It is fantastic!  (We're in Virginia.)  The workmanship / enginerring is really quite impressive; the manufacturers really know what they are doing.  The two men who installed it were Czech, and one of them told me he started out with the company working in the factory twenty years ago; obviously quite proud of being part of it.  It's letting us keep our pool open all winter; we had a foot of snow a month ago, and it was great to be able to use the pool through that time. I was impressed how well it contains sound as well -- we often like to play music as we swim, and you can't hear it outside, so I know we are not disturbing our neighbors. I swim twice a day now.
reviews.author: craig vasey

reviews.text:
I highly recommend the Laguna pool enclosure for those with inground pools in cooler climates. We have had our enclosure for five months now, so I feel ready to post a review. First of all, all of the marketing hype about the product is true. The enclosure is solidly engineered, and impressively easy to reconfigure, depending on the weather. The installation was completed in exactly one day as scheduled by a very competent team, including two factory representatives. The enclosure has enabled us to keep our pool open year-round, although we choose not to swim on the coldest days, because the air temperature in the enclosure tends to run about halfway between the pool temperature and the outside air temperature when it’s cloudy. By using a thermal blanket inside the enclosure, we’ve been able to keep our heating bills reasonable and hold down the humidity inside.

The clear polycarbonate that we chose affords us a wonderful view of the woods around us, while keeping out leaves in the autumn and bugs in the summer. It takes about three or four minutes to open up the enclosure completely on a sunny day. Our two-year-old granddaughter was strong enough to push one of the segments by herself, so the videos suggesting that it is easy are right on the mark.

It is an expensive product, but very well worth it because we get an extra seven months a year from our pool. We are very satisfied.
reviews.author: John Piescik

reviews.text:
It's great to have one of these enclosures.  Ours was installed in early June 2021 in 2.5 days by factory technicians. Polite and very knowledgeable individuals.
Ours is a 22 ft wide by 42 ft long unit consisting of 6 sections.
So far we have been able to use the pool every day since installation.  It helps keep out bad weather to allow use when rainy or chilly.   It may get a little humid inside on these occasions but cracking open one section by a few feet helps quite a bit.  Very solid construction with all the materials we ordered and all rust free.
To open and close is really as simple as sliding the section down the track, and latching it in place (open or closed position).
Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Gary Deck

reviews.text:
Was not cheap but worth the money. Alex and the crew were great. Its going to add a great addition to the play area. I highly recommend going to there office, like I did to meet with them to discuss the planning so no hiccups
I can't say enough good things
reviews.author: George Ade

reviews.text:
Awesome installation.
Use the pool 365 days rain snow shine no worries. by the way you don’t have to clean it 99% of the time.
reviews.author: Lakshan

reviews.text:
Before we chose Pool and Spa Enclosures we did hours of research. There were two other companies that offered a cheaper rate. We went to see multiple different pools before making out decision. Ultimately after interviewing people we chose Alex and Dan and I have no regrets. It was worth every penny. Honestly, the service we got was above and beyond the dollar value. From the beginning Alex was easy to communicate with. He provided references and people for us to talk to. Everyone we spoke to was thrilled with his work. Every time I called or emailed him, he responded within a couple of hours. Even after the installation- he made himself available for questions. And we had a LOT of questions! The enclosure was customized for our needs specifically and was a perfect in reality as it was in the blueprints. Alex never once lost patience with us. He even answered questions about our pool reno that were super helpful (more helpful than our pool company who were very difficult to communicate with!). The enclosure arrived earlier than expected and the guys who did the install were very professional. When they first started it looked like there was going to be a huge mess- but by the time they were done they had cleaned up so well it was almost like they hadn’t been there! The yard was left clean and beautiful.
As for the enclosure itself, it’s been almost 4 months now. We got it done at the beginning of the winter and it’s working wonderfully! The enclosure keeps the area mostly warm and everyone who uses the pool is completely in awe of how gorgeous it is. Yes you can Swim All Year! The retractable pool enclosure allows us to swim in New York 365 days a year! One of my friends came to see it and was blown away. “I thought you guys were just getting a pool bubble- but this is exponentially better!” I highly recommend  Pool and Spa Enclosures for your enclosure needs.
reviews.author: Zahava Shapiro

reviews.text: We have enjoyed our enclosure for one month now from installation. It is a true delight from blocking cool breezes allowing us more time in our pool to being able to open it fully when we enjoy the sun. As a device it is easy to operate. The sections roll open with one hand and the added security of locking our pool completes our comfort level to the maximum. It has become an extra room to our home even if it is detached. We celebrate Pool and Spa Enclosures' people AJ and Dan's expert guidance through our process. We have imagined a cover on our pool for over ten years and these people were the perfect fit for us. And do not miss the factory installers. After unloading late afternoon and unpacking a few things they hit the ground running at eight the next morning. By two-o-clock that afternoon they were finished, cleaned up, and gave us a the few instructions needed. Fanta and Tomas were a wonderful crew. Highly recommend this product for anyone wanting to make their pool experience great. No leaves in the pool, fewer chemicals necessary, and less energy spent on heating. What's not to love?!!
reviews.author: Irv Meurer

reviews.text:
We love our pool enclosure. Dan and his team were so incredible to work with. They made the process very easy, from start to finish.
We researched other pool enclosure options; this company definitely provided the best product available to meet our needs. Their pricing was affordable and allowed us to add in additional features to meet our needs. They have so many sizes and configurations to choose from, plus options for finishes and baffles for cold weather usage. For far less than we thought, we were able to get the enclosure of our dreams. Also their installation team is top notch. Thomas and Fonda are precision engineers. All business and they don’t mess around. Very good guys who took the time to explain all our enclosure features. They take great pride in their work and it shows.
Thank you, Dan and your entire Pool and Spa Enclosures team! We are beyond thrilled!!

reviews.text:

The materials used incredible quality! We are so pleased and who sees it says simply amazing!

reviews.text: Fantastic pool enclosure! I had mine installed in Nov 2015 and I've enjoyed swimming year round in Maryland even though a blizzard (I have a gas pool heater). The UV protection from the panels enables my family to be in the pool without using sunscreen AND it cuts down on the pool chemical costs because the chlorine in the pool doesn't burn off from direct sunlight. Probably the single best pool-related purchase I ever made.
reviews.author: Rithy Chhay

reviews.text:
Our pool enclosure was damaged during a sudden unforecast windstorm at the end of October. With winter only two months away we worried that we would be forced to shutdown our pool until spring.

Not to worry! Dan Stonkus saw to all the details of fabricating the replacement facing at the Czech Republic factory, shipping it across the Atlantic to New Jersey and then trucking it to our home in Gloucester Massachusetts. Two smiling enclosure experts installed the facing before Noon and our enclosure is ready to shelter our heated pool for many years to come.

(All I needed to do was send photos of the wind damage to Dan.)

This is real world five star product service.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.author: Bill Wolbach

reviews.text: Amazing, it was a pleasure working with Alex and Dan. Then came the installation, again,....amazing, their 6 men crew very professional, clean and polite. AJ our salesmen, spoke to all our neighbors and several builders explained exactly what was going on and the purpose for the pool enclosure. Thank you again for a great experience. PS I would give them 10 Stars if it was available. Once I get my camera working I'll post pictures.

reviews.text:
I always hesitate to post reviews until that peaches and cream feeling of having something new and unique has faded.
Now that we have owned our enclosure for about seven seasons (almost 2 years) ,I can tell you how happy we are with the decision to go with P.S.E. Alex, John and all involved were terrific and easy to work with.
The installation was coordinated with the pool co. flawlessly . Alex's people were so professional and pleasant and had it installed in about 6 hours.
We were swimming in N.J. on Christmas day  2019.
Over time a few minor issues came up. REMEMBER this was during the worst of  covid . Knowing that I purchased a very special item . I must say that  Alex sent me the part I needed almost immediately .
About months ago I had to have a repair made to a bit of damage to  one of the panels .
I informed Alex and he assured me that as soon as covid restrictions were lifted on flights to the U.S. his workers would be here.
About 5 months ago they showed up and within 45 minutes they had flawlessly repaired the damage . No charge. In no way does  this company forget about you after the purchase. If you are fortunate enough to be able to afford something as unique and so functional as this,you may have to exercise some patience .But trust me you will be taken care of.
Bottom line  we suggest that anyone who is looking to get maximum enjoyment from your pool and spa to go with P.S.E they are good people.
We would not have a pool  without one of Alex's Enclosures .
reviews.author: William Dantinne

reviews.text: Enclosure is exceeding my expectations.  Metal work is flawless, great attention to detail and is built quite stout.  Chlorine requirements have dropped to around 25% of what was previously needed.  Water usage has dropped in half.  Amazing how much heat the water absorbs!  Alex was most helpful in all phases of the project.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Sachs

reviews.text:
We were hoping to cover our pool with the goal of the greenhouse effect to keep the water cleaner and warmer. we have a mild, cool climate in santa cruz, with temperatures in the 70s-80s. However, we get full sun almost all the time.

Our goals are completely accomplished with the alukov pool cover, along with a little more gap-covering. The ambient air temperature inside the enclosure gets over 110 degrees F, making the 88-90 degree water very nice to swim in.

We do have an electric heater with the pool equipment, but we have not had to use it at all from March through November. So here on the central coast of California we have only December through February that we need a small amount of help from the pool heater.

We have found that the heat is very well contained and although the ambient air inside the cover does vary quite a bit, the water temperature does not. We lose 1-2 degrees at night and that's all.

We are so thrilled with our cover because it has changed our life. We love the water, the no-impact resistance exercising. Just having the freedom to use the pool as much as we want has been so good for us.

Thanks john, for helping us design the perfect cover for our pool and our back yard. -Julianne and Riz
reviews.author: Julianne Passiflora

reviews.text: We had an unusually shaped pool close to the house. They worked with us to create a beautiful and functional enclosure . Swimming all winter in Colorado is amazing!
